extracted.WHY_THIS_MATTERS: Test vector 11 is a savings-delta calculation. The delta between self-pay and list is the headline number a patient will act on. A $27 spread in the denominator is small in dollars but it is the difference between a correct and an incorrect advertised saving, and the spread may not be noise: $1,059.87 and $1,086 could reflect different dose strengths, different units (per vial vs per month, four vials vs one), different dates, or vial versus pen list prices. Averaging them would be a fabrication.
extracted.unit_ambiguity_unresolved: None of the located figures state unambiguously whether they are per month of therapy, per single-dose vial, per four-vial carton, or per KwikPen. Lilly's own pricinginfo page would settle this and could not be read.
extracted.DO_NOT_RECONCILE: Per the rules of evidence these figures must be reported as a conflict, not resolved into a midpoint. No list price may be shipped until pricinginfo.lilly.com or an SEC filing is read directly.
